Topics · One God, one message

If God wanted one religion, why are there so many?

God could have made one community and did not. The Quran says why, and parts God's variety from human rivalry.

Part 1 of 4

﴿وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَمُهَيْمِنًا عَلَيْهِ ۖ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ عَمَّا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ لِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مِنكُمْ شِرْعَةً وَمِنْهَاجًا ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَـٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِى مَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۖ فَٱسْتَبِقُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] in truth, confirming that which preceded it of the Scripture and as a criterion over it. So judge between them by what Allāh has revealed and do not follow their inclinations away from what has come to you of the truth. To each of you We prescribed a law and a method.[268] Had Allāh willed, He would have made you one nation [united in religion], but [He intended] to test you in what He has given you; so race to [all that is] good.[269] To Allāh is your return all together, and He will [then] inform you concerning that over which you used to differ.

Translator's notes

[268] Prior to this revelation, which supersedes all previous scriptures. [269] i.e., obedience to Allāh according to what He enjoined in the Qur’ān and through the sunnah of His Prophet (ﷺ).

Quran · Al-Ma'idah 5:48

Translation

The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether. They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb. Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

Original · Hebrew

יִרְאַ֤ת יְהוָ֨ה ׀ טְהוֹרָה֮ עוֹמֶ֪דֶת לָ֫עַ֥ד מִֽשְׁפְּטֵי־יְהוָ֥ה אֱמֶ֑ת צָֽדְק֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃ הַֽנֶּחֱמָדִ֗ים מִ֭זָּהָב וּמִפַּ֣ז רָ֑ב וּמְתוּקִ֥ים מִ֝דְּבַ֗שׁ וְנֹ֣פֶת צוּפִֽים׃ גַּֽם־עַ֭בְדְּךָ נִזְהָ֣ר בָּהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְרָ֗ם עֵ֣קֶב רָֽב׃

the Psalms · 19:9-11

World English Bible

Take the question at full strength. If God is all-powerful and wanted one religion, one religion is what there would be. The verse says exactly that, and says it first: had God willed, He would have made you one community. So plurality is no surprise to the book, and no defeat of anything. It gives the reason: that He may test you in what He has given you. Then the test becomes a direction: race toward what is good.

A question for you

If every person on earth held the same belief because they had no alternative, what would that belief be worth?

If you sayNot much; it would not be theirs
ThenThat is close to what the verse says about why variety exists: a belief that cannot be refused cannot really be given.
If you sayStill something; peace has value
ThenPeace is a real good, and the verse does not dismiss it. It places a different good beside it: that a belief be one's own.
If you sayIt depends what the belief was
ThenA fair thing to ask. The verse says what the point of the arrangement is, and leaves the content of the belief to the rest of the series.

Part 2 of 4

﴿وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَـَٔامَنَ مَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ كُلُّهُمْ جَمِيعًا ۚ أَفَأَنتَ تُكْرِهُ ٱلنَّاسَ حَتَّىٰ يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And had your Lord willed, those on earth would have believed - all of them entirely. Then, [O Muḥammad], would you compel the people in order that they become believers?

Philemon · 1:14

World English Bible

﴿وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً ۖ وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And if your Lord had willed, He could have made mankind one community; but they will not cease to differ,

Quran · Hud 11:118

The same point comes from another side. Belief that is forced is not belief; it is behaviour. Whoever wanted belief, as opposed to compliance, would have to leave room for refusing it. The verse puts it as a question to the one delivering the message: will you compel people until they believe? The answer is built into the question. The second verse adds that people will not cease to differ.

A question for you

Do you know a case where pressure produced faith that lasted?

If you sayYes
ThenIt happens, and the person who has it can tell you whether it was the pressure or something that came after. The verses are about what is worth wanting, not about what is possible.
If you sayNo; it produced silence
ThenThat is the common report. Pressure tends to produce compliance, and often a quiet resentment that surfaces later.
If you sayBoth, in different people
ThenThat fits what people observe. The verses' point is the difference between the two.

﴿يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَـٰكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ﴾

﴿وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَـٰفُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَٰنِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْعَـٰلِمِينَ﴾

Quran · Ar-Rum 30:22

Translation

Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

Original · Hebrew

הֲֽ֝לֹא־בַ֭בֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂ֣נִי עָשָׂ֑הוּ וַ֝יְכֻנֶ֗נּוּ בָּרֶ֥חֶם אֶחָֽד׃

Job · 31:15

World English Bible

Some differences are not a problem to solve. Peoples and tribes, says the verse, were made so that you may know one another. Another verse counts the variety of tongues and colours among the signs. So some difference is there on purpose, and we are meant to read it as an invitation to meet, not a reason to fight. The measure of honour the verse gives is none of these differences.

A question for you

Which kind of difference has enriched your life?

If you sayPeople who grew up differently from me
ThenThat is the kind the verse names: peoples and tribes, made so that you know each other.
If you sayLanguages and places
ThenLanguages are on the verse's list of signs. A language you do not speak is a door you have not yet opened.
If you sayHonestly, mostly it has not
ThenThat is an honest answer, and a common one. The verse is about what difference is for, not a claim that it is always comfortable.

Part 4 of 4

﴿وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى لَّقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word[1413] that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt.

Translator's notes

[1413] Decree. See footnote to 10:19.

Quran · Ash-Shura 42:14

Translation

for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?

Original · Ancient Greek

ἔτι γὰρ σαρκικοί ἐστε. ὅπου γὰρ ἐν ὑμῖν ζῆλος καὶ ἔρις, οὐχὶ σαρκικοί ἐστε καὶ κατὰ ἄνθρωπον περιπατεῖτε;

1 Corinthians · 3:3

World English Bible

The book separates two things sharply. Difference in language, colour, and even in the law each community was given, is placed with God. Splitting the religion into camps is placed with people: they only divided after knowledge reached them, out of rivalry among themselves. So the many religions are two things stacked together: God's variety, and our rivalry. The verse does not say which is which in every case. It says the rivalry is ours.

A question for you

Looking at religious divisions you know, which is the bigger part?

If you sayReal differences in belief
ThenSome are real, and the verse does not deny it. The question is whether those differences had to become divisions.
If you sayRivalry over who leads and who is right
ThenThat is the verse's claim. It is also easy to say about other people's divisions; try it on your own side.
If you sayBoth, tangled together
ThenProbably the most accurate answer. The verse asks only that the second part not be left out of the account.
